propositions: Twenty-seven defects in fortnight review were tests that could not fail or wasted CI time due to absent subprocess return-code checks, unconstrained test durations, and timeout oracle expiration.

Per-test timeout budget (20 seconds with func_only=True) and explicit check= policies for subprocess.run calls are not configured or enforced locally; only CI workflow steps carry --timeout=300 flags.

Ruff does not select PLW1510 or the specific PT codes (PT001,PT006,PT007,PT008,PT012,PT013,PT017,PT021,PT022,PT028) that prevent common test-writing mistakes; 481 findings exist tree-wide in src/, tests/, and scripts/.
Hygiene check scripts (check_wall_clock_asserts.py, check_raw_git_writes.py) exist and run in CI but are not reachable from make lint.

Unit-tier tests fit within a 20-second per-test budget when measured under --timeout=20 --timeout-method=thread; integration-tier slow tests require explicit @pytest.mark.timeout(N, func_only=True) marks before lowering CI flags from 300 to 20 seconds.

Configuration changes (ruff select list, pytest ini keys, CI flag reduction, make lint recipe) must be guarded by assertions (test_ruff_ratchet.py membership tests, test_ci_workflow_parity.py drift check) to prevent regression.
